{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Midi wrap dress, A-line cut, hem just below the knee, deep forest green (#2F4F3E), matte crepe with a soft drape and long sleeves

Tailored blazer, single-breasted, hip length, soft camel (#B98F63), fine wool-blend with a subtle texture

Pointed-toe block-heel pumps, 6 cm heel, ankle height, warm taupe (#8B7765), smooth leather

Structured top-handle bag, small, cognac (#9A5B32), smooth leather

Thin gold-tone belt or delicate drop earrings, small, gold (#C9A24B), polished metal

Sheer tights, natural nude (#C9A184), fine knit

Why this outfit works: The forest green wrap dress is classic and polished, so it reads as respectful and put together at a family celebration at a restaurant, with nothing in it that invites comment. Its deep tone suits your warm skin, golden hair and grey-green eyes, and the wrap shape defines the waist while the skirt skims the hips gently. The camel blazer adds a smart layer for an autumn Saturday, and the modest knee-below length and long sleeves keep the look conservative. Taupe pumps, a cognac bag and soft gold details keep the palette warm and cohesive, with comfortable heels for a long meal."}
